candidates.rationale: Realtime is keyed to the vendor static at ridebasintransit.com/gtfs rather than the registered Trillium build. Trip IDs embed the same underlying number inside a longer Trillium ID, so no trip resolves on an exact match. Usable only if the vendor static were registered alongside it.
